note: Rewritten from Chhotani (1997), entry 137; the original is in English. The original figure for the maximum width of the soldier postmentum contains OCR damage (“O.32-0.3~”) and that value is not recorded. The synonym list, literature citations, figure numbers, type-measurement table, distribution records and the discussion of the records from Thailand and Malaysia have been omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head brown, darker anteriorly; antennae and labrum light brown; mandibles dark reddish black; body yellow. Body length 4.08–5.5 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, length to the mandibular base 1.57–1.90, width 0.91–1.09 mm; the width slightly more than half the length, the width/length ratio 0.56–0.60. Fontanelle minute, at about 1/3 of the head from the front. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Labrum subsquare, the anterior margin rounded, not narrowed to a point. Postclypeus not clearly delimited from the frontal surface. Mandibles short, thick and robust, slightly longer than half the head length, length 0.90–1.18 mm, the ratio of left mandible length to head length 0.51–0.60; the mandibles coarsely serrate, with a large tooth-like process slightly below the middle, the apex strongly incurved. Postmentum rod-like, with a long and narrow waist, length 0.92–1.19, waist width 0.17–0.27 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior margin deeply concave, the posterior margin nearly straight, length 0.30–0.41, width 0.55–0.73 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule straw-coloured, antennae and body pale yellow. Head and body rather densely hairy. Body length 4.0–4.6 mm. Head capsule somewhat square, length to the mandibular base 0.97–1.05, maximum width 0.91–0.97 mm. Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus swollen, slightly more than half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior margin markedly concave, the posterior margin slightly concave in the middle, length 0.17–0.27, width 0.50–0.57 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule, pronotum and abdominal tergites chestnut brown; postclypeus paler; legs and abdominal sternites pale yellow; wings smoky brown. Head and body densely hairy. Body length with wings 7.3–9.0 mm, without wings 4.5–5.5 mm. Head capsule subsquare, length to the mandibular base 0.77–0.91, width including the eyes 0.80–0.98 mm; the Y-shaped suture distinct. Fontanelle plate small, smoky yellow, central. Eyes subcircular, maximum diameter 0.22–0.26 mm, about 1/2 of their diameter from the lower margin of the head. Ocelli oval, long diameter 0.07–0.09, short diameter 0.05–0.06 mm, about their long diameter from the eyes, that is, 0.062–0.068 mm. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus moderately swollen, slightly less than or about half as long as wide. Pronotum flat, subtrapezoidal, length 0.41–0.49, width 0.62–0.72 mm; the anterior margin straight, without a median concavity, the posterior margin convex with a shallow median concavity. The wing margins are hairy and the membrane bears micrasters; fore wing length 6.0–6.4, hind wing length 5.8–6.0 mm.
